name: Silver Thread
desc: Same-suit builds. Patience over speed — runs must share a suit.

name: One Shot
desc: The stock never recycles. Make every draw count.

desc: Empty columns can never be refilled. Plan your kings.

desc: Foundations build King down to Ace. The table is inverted.

desc: No runs may be moved together. Every card travels alone.

name: The Gauntlet
desc: Everything hard at once. For veterans only.
